name: catch-up
description: Reads the messages of a channel a member has not read yet and says what happened, what was decided, what is still open and what is for them.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One or two sentences: what happened while the member was away

fields.name: decided
fields.description: What was decided, one line each

fields.name: open
fields.description: What is still open, one line each

fields.name: forYou
fields.description: What asks something of the member or names them, one line each
